Front three-quarter view, gentle side illumination and cast shadow; no plants, labels or extra props.
Preserve: Soften hard edges into silk folds while preserving observed contours, apertures and part relationships; do not close essential gaps. Preserve identifying features and required negative spaces, subject to the explicitly permitted transformation. Keep the complete transformed subject within the input aspect ratio.
medium: A soft sculptural reinterpretation of the observed object, fully shaped from flowing silk with coherent folds.
composition: Preserve the source object silhouette, viewpoint and essential openings while allowing gentle fabric softening of hard edges.
texture: Use fine woven silk, long tension folds and small gathered creases that follow the object volume and attachment points.
palette: Translate observed object colors into dyed silk; keep light and dark regions legible without adding printed patterns.
lighting: Create broad anisotropic silk highlights and soft fold shadows; avoid metallic reflection, plastic gloss and inflated-rubber surfaces.
detail: Keep source apertures open and separate touching parts; folds must not invent handles, limbs or functional components.
finish: Deliver one finished image at the input aspect ratio, without comparison panels, unrequested text, logos, signatures or watermarks.
Avoid: Invented people, duplicate main subjects, extra limbs, disconnected anatomy or accidental clipping. Unrequested titles, logos, signatures, watermarks, fabricated labels or before-and-after panels. A generic filter without the requested medium-specific physical or optical mechanism.
